notes.title: 🔥 Spirit Mancer – Physical Release for PS5 and Switch 🔥
notes.notes:
As Plug In Digital, we are very happy to announce a new collaboration with the Spanish publisher and distributor [b]Tesura Games[/b], alongside the talented developers at[b] Sunny Syrup Studio[/b]. Get ready to slash, shoot, and break demons in the exciting [b]new physical release of Spirit Mancer[/b]. This thrilling hack & slash deckbuilding game will launch in both Standard and Collector’s Editions for [b]PlayStation 5[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] on[b] January 31, 2025[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/97b4486112e78c3e2e33156926a511761defff4d.jpg[/img]

[b]Spirit Mancer Collector’s Edition includes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Full Game Complete-in-Cart (NSW/PS5)
[*] Collector’s Box
[*] The Artbook of Spirit Mancer 154 pp.
[*] Comic Book +  100 pp.
[*] OST CD
[/list]
Feel the wrath of the Spirit Mancer and [b]pre-order it now[/b] at main retailers like the [b][url=https://store.tesuragames.com/productos/?_search=Spirit%20Mancer]Tesura Store[/url][/b] in Standard and Collector’s Edition!


🔥 [b]Join our community & see you soon in the Inferno![/b] 🔥

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.7
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Spirit Mancers,
[/b]
We hope you are enjoying your time in the inferno. 

Please, find the patch note below!

[h2]Patch 1.0.7
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix Incorrect challenge's text.
[*] Fix description on the Valac II card.
[*] Fix issue where upgrades at the Adventurer's Guild remain locked. 
[*] Fix issue with Adventurer's Guild UI.
[*] Decrease Blaster shoot delay.
[*] Fix Card crafting issue.
[*] Fix issue when use slam attack with Knuckle underwater.
[*] Fix issue where gem damage calculate incorrectly.
[*] Fix issue where Anan enter hub world cutscene is missing. 
[*] Fix issue with corrupt image sprite when fishing.
[*] Fix Blaster and Bow counter issue.
[*] Fix issue when Summon spirit as soon as you seal it cause the monster to freeze.
[*] Fix issue when both player select the same character at the same time.
[*] Fix issue where Player can get stuck on bouncy surface.
[*] Fix issue in The Great Train Heist side mission where it can be completed with out eliminate every monster.
[*] Fix issue where NPC using keep speaking old text from previous chapter.
[*] Fix issue where text out of border in Adventurer's Guild in French and German.
[*] Fix where destructible objects sometimes can't be destroyed or take more hits than usual to get destroy.
[*] Fix issue during Co-op mode, unplugging P2 controller will cause P1 to freeze when entering a building.
[*] Fix missing Belial BGM in the boss fight.
[*] Fix missing Furcas BGM in the boss fight. 
[/list]
